description.text:
The deck that won the 11 to 14 division of the 2006 World Championships, the first world title for a player from Europe. Its Lunatone and Solrock together shut off other Pokémon's Poké-Powers, a choice made to beat the popular Blastoise, Lugia and Steelix decks, and many Trainer and Stadium cards give it control of the game. The 2006 World Championships were held at the Hilton Anaheim in Anaheim, California, from 18 to 20 August 2006.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2006 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
